# X-HD External Data Area

This directory is for locally acquired third-party datasets used by X-HD paper
reproduction experiments.

Large archives and extracted mesh files are intentionally ignored by git. Keep
small acquisition manifests and README files under version control so that
reviewers can see source URLs, hashes, and claim boundaries without requiring
the raw datasets to be committed.

Important boundary:

- files here are not exact X-HD paper inputs unless file/hash/provenance evidence
  proves that;
- public source data with matching names or similar counts is only Level B
  same-source representative evidence;
- exact paper dataset reproduction remains Level C and requires stronger proof.
